answer: Locks are published in mirror, expire in vault, and oasis lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 84 aliases therefore needs 188 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3913 identities would post 4435 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
